Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At the grocery store, a Roma woman and an African American woman were finishing their shopping and each had a whole cart full of food for the week, as they each had a pretty big family. Once they got to checkout, the Roma woman got through everything quickly because she just handed the cashier cash, but it took awhile longer for the African American woman, since the cashier had to remove several items that couldn't be purchased using her benefits card. Who buys food with cash?
A. The African American woman
B. Not enough information
C. The Roma woman
